-- ./audit_logs/ab_test.db --
ab_test_runs                 godot_state_events         
alerts_sent                  resource_contention_log    
auto_heal_actions            resource_contention_log_old
fix_patterns                 rule_compliance            
godot_log_entries          
resource_contention_log_old
resource_contention_log
godot_log_entries
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "resource_contention_log_old" (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                session_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                godot_pid INTEGER NOT NULL,
                ts INTEGER,
                io_wait INTEGER,
                vol_cs INTEGER,
                nvol_cs INTEGER,
                timestamp DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            );
CREATE TABLE resource_contention_log (
                        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                        session_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                        godot_pid INTEGER NOT NULL,
                        ts INTEGER,
                        io_wait INTEGER,
                        vol_cs INTEGER,
                        nvol_cs INTEGER,
                        timestamp DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                        FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES ab_test_runs(session_id)
                    );
CREATE INDEX idx_contention_session ON resource_contention_log(session_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_contention_ts ON resource_contention_log(ts);
CREATE TABLE godot_log_entries (
                entry_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                run_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                session_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                timestamp TEXT,
                verbatim TEXT,
                raw_json TEXT,
                FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES ab_test_runs(run_id),

            );

4)\n            end = min(len(lines), line_no + 3)\n            log(f\"  Match {i+1} at line {line_no}:\")\n            for j in range(start, end):\n                marker = \" -> \" if j == line_no - 1 else \"    \"\n                log(f\"    {marker} {j+1}: {lines[j].rstrip()}\")\n        return True\n    else:\n        # Find the most likely location where the pattern should be\n        # Look for lines containing print or log\n        for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):\n            if re.search(r'\\b(print|log)\\s*\\(', line):\n                start = max(0, i -       "code": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# diagnose_verbatim.py – Diagnostic tool for R140–R143 compliance.\n# Outputs every check with timestamps, line numbers, and context.\n\nimport re\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\ndef ts():\n    return datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds')\n\ndef log(msg):\n    print(f\"[{ts()}] {msg}\")\n\ndef examine_pattern(src, pattern, description, lines):\n    \"\"\"Search for pattern. Print context for first 5 matches or the first missing line.\"\"\"\n    log(f\"CHECK: {description}\")\n    log(f\"  PATTERN: {pattern}\")\n    matches = list(re.finditer(pattern, src, re.IGNORECASE))\n    if matches:\n        log(f\"  RESULT: FOUND {len(matches)} occurrence(s)\")\n        # Show the first 3 matches with context\n        for i, m in enumerate(matches[:3]):\n            line_no = src[:m.start()].count('\\n') + 1\n            start = max(0, line_no -
